title: NotifyIsland settings
heading: Capsule
lang_h: Russian is the default. English is a real string table, not machine translation.
palette_h: Preset colors. Midnight is the quiet Win11-dark default.
accent_h: HEX like #3D9CF0. Empty uses the palette accent.
font_h: Segoe Variable stays readable on a narrow pill.
icons_h: Fluent, not SF Symbols. Filled is denser; MDL2 is Segoe system glyphs.
opacity_h: 0.90–0.94 so the pill does not fight the wallpaper.
glass_h: Alpha only, no Mica. 0 keeps a solid fill.
border_h: 1 px is enough. Past 2 px it reads as a frame.
glow_h: Soft halo. Incoming calls pulse the glow only, not the HWND.
radius_h: 0 = half height (capsule). Set a number only if you do not want a pill.
motion_extra_h: Invoke is a 0.98 scale. Breathe is glow-only.
expand_speed_h: Keep it snappy. 167 ms Fast, or 250 ms if the width jump is large.
collapse_speed_h: Slower than expand. 300–330 ms Soft-Out: fade text, then shrink width.
clock_h: HH:mm is shortest. Seconds steal space from weather.
density_h: Compact tightens padding. Do not pair Large icons with Compact.
idle_w_h: Clock + badge + weather. 180 is fine on Full HD.
idle_h_h: One height for every state. Width grows; height stays put.
expand_h_h: Off = one row (recommended). On = a taller card.
max_w_h: Stops a toast from spanning the screen.
text_size_h: S / M / L, independent of icons. Grow width, not height.
icon_size_h: Must fit one row with the clock.
badge: App badge left of the clock
badge_h: Count survives after the toast. Real logos only if Windows allows notification access.
badge_style_h: Icon+count is clearest. Dot is quieter.
weather_on_h: No API key. Chip sits right of the clock.
location_h: If denied, the city field is used. Temperature is never faked.
sounds_on_h: Not system volume. Short WAVs, gain capped.
sys_vol_h: Same Core Audio slider as in the capsule player panel.
click_h: First click: Notification Center. Second: player + system volume. Shift still expands.
hover_h: Short peek. Turn off during F9 demo.
toasts_h: Needs UserNotificationListener. Unpackaged apps often get Denied — we never fake Allowed.
render_mode_h: Default is the fixed strip (HWND stays still). If motion still stutters on your GPU, switch to resize-window and tell us which is smoother.
whats_new_body: 1.3.2: the pill animates width/clip only — text is never scaled. Corners stay height/2; the host strip is never painted. Clock is HH:mm. Weather stays inside the capsule (temp only). Please still judge smoothness on your GPU.
toast_unsigned: This build is unpackaged. The toast listener is usually Denied. Open Settings → Privacy → Notifications. Full log: %TEMP%\notifyisland.log.
